status: best candidate of the guarded search; NOT accepted (deflated Sharpe 0.41 < 0.95 after 37 trials) - test-year run is informative only
description: Events: 5-minute moves beyond 3 standard deviations on 12 USD-M perpetuals (decision one minute after the 5-minute close). A LightGBM regression (huber) predicts the 4-hour forward log return from 23 features (move size and coin-specific part, open-interest change over 5 min/1 h/1 day, taker buy/sell ratio over 5 min/1 h, top-trader and crowd long/short ratios, last funding, market return over 1 h/1 d/3 d, volatility level, hour, weekday, minutes to funding) plus the coin; retrained at the start of every month on all events whose label was complete before it. Buy at market when the forecast exceeds +60 bp (strongest forecast first), sell at market 240 minutes later. 20 % of equity per trade, open positions capped at 1x equity.

timing_fix.why: Live API check: the archive's open-interest and long/short values stamped X equal the live values stamped X+5 min (published 1-2.3 min later) and its taker ratio stamped X is published 7.6 min after X. The first runs used them from X+1 min (about 6-8 minutes of look-ahead). With metrics_lag=2 a decision at T+1 min uses only values stamped T-10 min or earlier, all published by then.
timing_fix.effect: the result does not depend on the look-ahead; the corrected timing is used from now on (forward and live tests)
